question_record.context: A series of security alerts were noted, including a suspicious account creation, user and IP address reconnaissance via SMB, and a suspected overpass-the-hash attack involving authentication attempts against VNEVADO-DC.
question_record.question: Who was the individual identified as the Helpdesk Administrator attempting to authenticate against VNEVADO-DC during the suspected overpass-the-hash attack (Kerberos)?
solution: A new user account with AadUserId `1d94aaf6-efe6-4e76-ad56-ffd7d1257bc1` was created, which might indicate an attempt to maintain access to the device or organization.
Ethan Brooks (Account Executive) on host `VNEVADO-Win10V` enumerated SMB sessions on host `VNEVADO-DC`, retrieving recent IP addresses of 2 accounts.
Emma Clark (Helpdesk Administrator) on host `VNEVADO-Win10V` attempted to authenticate against host `VNEVADO-DC`, which might indicate a suspected overpass-the-hash attack.

48.name: Suspicious account creation
48.description: A new user account was created. A new user account can be created to establish a secondary of backup access to the device or services within the organization. An attacker might be attempting to maintain access to the device or organization.

114.name: User and IP address reconnaissance (SMB)
114.description: Ethan Brooks (Account Executive) on VNEVADO-Win10V enumerated SMB sessions on VNEVADO-DC, retrieving recent IP addresses of 2 accounts.

119.name: Suspected overpass-the-hash attack (Kerberos)
119.description: Emma Clark (Helpdesk Administrator) on VNEVADO-Win10V attempted to authenticate against VNEVADO-DC.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning
